# leptonica / jpegiostub_fuzzer

leptonica's own fuzz target `jpegiostub_fuzzer` ([source](source/jpegiostub_fuzzer.cc), unmodified), one of the targets OSS-Fuzz builds, over leptonica (DanBloomberg/leptonica at 10bdea2f).

pixReadMemSpix, then pixSetChromaSampling(pix, 0).

## How this program differs from what OSS-Fuzz runs
- Linked against leptonica at commit 10bdea2f.
- In every build, getenv() returns NULL, getpid() returns 1 and mkstemp() uses a fixed name, so the program depends only on its input.
- A small driver reads the input file, calls the harness one to four times and prints each return value.

## What the harness checks
The harness makes no check of its own beyond not crashing, so a statement about it says only that the code it calls never crashes, hangs or trips a sanitizer.

## Builds
Static riscv64 Linux programs, compiled for RV64G and run as `<file> <input-file>`; `oft fetch leptonica` downloads the published ones and checks each against its SHA-256.

| build | file | bytes | sha256 |
|---|---|---:|---|
| plain | `jpegiostub_fuzzer.plain` | 53,032 | `565d59923987f1b25290a0a1bd6b900d7e310f4f14c9d8d0a7e506ff438a0967` |
| ubsan | `jpegiostub_fuzzer.ubsan` | 54,640 | `7d122e3bdb7cebf1b5435c17b898853e6bd713613731f970dc7e006051eda845` |
| asan | `jpegiostub_fuzzer.asan` | 769,144 | `83f6d89c62e8d56bad79b275aabd651d028abcc6eeee3f24054622002c7a9dd2` |
| asan-ubsan | `jpegiostub_fuzzer.asan-ubsan` | 771,800 | `0999e7a53e70fe4a15d444dc0112d2292b9b194b1258942bd59c1dbc4d2d0388` |

Each build also links code that no sanitizer instruments, as its link recorded it. A statement about a sanitizer build covers that code only as uninstrumented code: ASan checks no load or store made inside it, and UBSan inserts no check there.

- plain: `clang_rt.crtbegin.o` (compiler-rt), `libclang_rt.builtins.a` (compiler-rt), `crt1.o` (the C library), `libc.a` (the C library)
- ubsan: `clang_rt.crtbegin.o` (compiler-rt), `libclang_rt.builtins.a` (compiler-rt), `crt1.o` (the C library), `libc.a` (the C library)
- asan: `clang_rt.crtbegin.o` (compiler-rt), `libclang_rt.asan.a` (the sanitizer runtime), `libclang_rt.builtins.a` (compiler-rt), `crt1.o` (the C library), `libc++.a` (the C++ runtime), `libc.a` (the C library), `libunwind.a` (the C++ runtime)
- asan-ubsan: `clang_rt.crtbegin.o` (compiler-rt), `libclang_rt.asan.a` (the sanitizer runtime), `libclang_rt.builtins.a` (compiler-rt), `crt1.o` (the C library), `libc++.a` (the C++ runtime), `libc.a` (the C library), `libunwind.a` (the C++ runtime)
